newsitem.title: USA: American Science settles suits with ex-CEO.
newsitem.headline: American Science settles suits with ex-CEO.

text.p: American Science and Engineering Inc said Thursday it settled a suit filed by its former chief executive, Martin Annis, and a counter claim it filed against Annis and AnnisTech Inc.

Under the settlement, AS&E has given AnnisTech a limited exclusive license for MeVScan, an invention by Annis and Richard Adler, chief executive North Star Research Corp, used in the production of moving x-ray pencil beams.
In return, AnnisTech will pay royalties on MeVScan sales, AS&E said.

The settlement gives AnnisTech and/or North Star exclusive ownership of imaging and control systems that North Star developed, a high energy x-ray source developed by North Star and developments in computerized tomography invented by Annis and Adler.
AS&E makes X-ray inspection products for critical detection and security applications, including technology to detect plastic explosives, illegal drugs, and other contraband.
